jobs.instructions: You classify changelog log entries. You are given the taxonomy (valid archetype and surface values), and a list of unclassified log entries (item id, title, body summary). For each entry choose exactly one archetype and one surface from the taxonomy. Respond with ONLY a JSON array: [{"item": "<id>", "archetype": "<value>", "surface": "<value>"}]. No other text.
jobs.name: Classification fallback

jobs.instructions: You suggest work bundles. You are given open items (id, title, priority, requirements). Propose up to 3 bundles of 2-3 items that are clearly compatible (same files/area, one coherent change). Respond with ONLY a JSON array: [{"item": "<primary id>", "bundle_with": ["<partner id>", "<partner id>"]}]. No other text. If nothing is compatible, respond with [].
jobs.name: Bundling suggestions
